text: グレー　バッジを　つけてると　それだけで　きみの　ポケモンは　つよくなる！

structure.jp: グレー　バッジを　つけてると
structure.en: when you are wearing the Boulder Badge,

structure.jp: きみの　ポケモンは

patterns.name: 〜と (whenever)
patterns.explanation: と after a verb says that whenever the first thing is true, the next thing always follows. つけてると = 'when you are wearing it'.

patterns.name: 〜くなる
patterns.explanation: Changing the い of a describing word to く and adding なる says something turns that way. つよくなる = 'become strong'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている after a verb says the state is ongoing; here it is shortened to てる, as people do in casual talk. つけてる = 'are wearing'.
